messages.subject: Python libraries?  Python scripts?
parts:
I have created a Shiny that uses a system call to run a python script and this script needs the libraries:  
numpy

httplib2

oauth2client.client

oauth2client.file

apiclient.discovery



Is Python available on the Shiny Server?  And if so, can these libraries be added?


Thanks so much!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Python libraries? Python scripts?
parts:
Hi Amanda,
Unfortunately we haven't added support for the installation of  python packages to shinyapps.  We hope to do that in the future, but it is likely after we makethe product generally available.
You might be able to get the capabilities you are looking for using the httr package in R.

Best,
Tareef
